_about: Strokes table for catalog/projects/playful-choker, read by scripts/pcb-export-to-map2d.py.
Object order is wire order; each object is one pen stroke (the resolver spreads its lamps evenly
along the polyline), so a stroke a pen cannot join is its own object. The concatenation of every
stroke's leds must equal the netlist chain; the script refuses to write otherwise.
Regenerate with `just pcb-map2d playful-choker <design-folder>`; add --check to verify instead.
svg_comment: PLAYFUL choker: every WS2812B-2020 on the PCB (positions from the EasyEDA
PCB export, chain from its netlist), numbered in the wire order
playful.map2d.json declares. Units are millimetres from the board's
top-left; one group per mapping object; the LEDn label is the PCB
designator. Generated by scripts/pcb-export-to-map2d.py: regenerate with
`just pcb-map2d playful-choker <exports>` rather than editing by hand.

strokes.name: P
strokes.stroke: stem up, top bar, bowl, middle bar back

strokes.name: A
strokes.stroke: left leg up, right leg down

strokes.name: F-lower
strokes.stroke: stem bottom to the middle bar

strokes.name: F-upper
strokes.stroke: stem on up, top bar left to right
